youtube_description:
#FlightOfTheNavigator #OfficialTrailer #LifeAftertheNavigator

OUT NOW in UK & US on AMAZON, and Region Free BluRay from www.lifeaftermovies.com (Ships WORLDWIDE!)

Excited to share the OFFICIAL TRAILER for our Flight of the Navigator documentary! LIFE AFTER THE NAVIGATOR is a feature documentary that celebrates the iconic 1986 classic from Randal Kleiser, Flight of the Navigator, and looks at the life of star Joey Cramer since that breakthrough role. 

The feature documentary was filmed over 3 years and features interviews with Flight of the Navigator cast and crew, including Joey Cramer, Randal Kleiser, Veronica Cartwright (of "Alien" fame), Cliff De Young, Matt Adler (of "North Shore" and "Teen Wolf" fame, Raymond Forchoin, Tim Blaney and Tony Urbano (also responsible for classics such as "Short Circuit"), Jeffrey Kleiser (the digital effects guru behind "Tron") and more.

Being huge fans of Flight of the Navigator, one of the greatest science fiction films of the 80s, with that incredibly iconic soundtrack by Alan Silvestri, it was amazing to really delve into what makes this film so special but also looks at the reality of Joey Cramer's life - you read headlines like Joey Cramer bank robbery or Joey Cramer former child star arrested, where are they now, stories on child actors, but the question is what happened?

In LIFE AFTER THE NAVIGATOR we answer that.

Brought to you by Spare Change Films, Strict Machine and Life After Movies - we LOVE 80s movies and 80s film, it's all about nostalgia!
